_note: Hand-maintained fields with no free no-login feed. fetch_data.py only reads this file, never writes it. Easiest way to update: open a new issue via the 'Update manual data' template (github.com/Addy662/macro-terminal/issues/new/choose) - a bot parses the form and commits here automatically. Or edit this file directly. Leave a field null if you haven't set it yet.

rbi_repo_rate._source: Set at the Oct 7 2026 MPC meeting (hiked from 5.25%) after Aug CPI ran hot. As of late Nov, Barclays/IDFC First/Choice Institutional converge on a further 25bp hike at the Dec 4 2026 meeting (Oct CPI broke above the 6% ceiling), with a ~6-6.25% terminal rate expected by Feb 2027. Verify/update before Dec 4 - this is a forecast, not a fact.

india_cpi._source: MoSPI release: Oct 2026 CPI YoY 6.09% (provisional), first print above RBI's 6% ceiling since Oct 2024; Sep 2026 was 5.54%.

india_gsec10y._source: Press-cited (tradingeconomics.com), not from an exact free API - treat as approximate, update when you have a sharper number.

consensus._note: Fill in shortly before each release so the dashboard can show the surprise (actual - expected). us_cpi/us_pce are YoY %, us_jobs is payrolls added in thousands, us_gdp is annualized QoQ %. As of 2026-11-22: us_pce and us_gdp are firmer (Admiral Markets preview / Trading Economics); us_cpi is a nowcast cluster, not an official Street poll yet; us_jobs is genuinely unsettled (trackers range ~50-62K) - re-verify all four closer to each release date (Dec 10, Nov 25, Nov 25, Dec 4 respectively).
